full_judgment: 12. The first information report disclosed that the petitioner had withdrawn Taka 6,51,015 during the period between 2-9-96 and 5-6-2000 without specifying various sums at different times in the course of a single year and mentioned period of misappropriation of the various items within a period of four years. The police report is also totally silent in this regard. The learned Magistrate, in the premises, has framed charge in contravention of section 233 of the Code. Sub-section (2) of section 222 provides that when an accused is charged with criminal breach of trust or dishonest misappropriation of money, a gross amount in respect of which the offence is alleged to have been committed and the dates between which the offence is alleged to have been committed, without specifying particular item or exact dates then the charge shall be framed in accordance with section 234. Section 234 provides that if an accused committed more offences than one of the same kind within a space of twelve months from the first to the last offence, he may be charged and tried at one trial, with any number of them not exceeding three. There is total misjoinder of charges and the learned Magistrate upon superficial consideration of the materials on record illegally framed charge against the petitioner for the alleged misappropriation of money.
